integrity_notes: No IMO number broadcast (not required for all hulls, but limits registry pivots)

pivots.label: MarineTraffic
pivots.note: Port calls and track history; free tier is time-limited

pivots.label: Global Fishing Watch
pivots.note: Free account; exposes AIS-off events and loitering for all vessel types

pivots.label: ITU MARS
pivots.note: Station licence record behind MMSI 538011728; confirms the issuing administration

pivots.label: Copernicus Browser
pivots.note: Free Sentinel-1 SAR. SAR sees hulls regardless of AIS, so this is how you test whether a gap was really a dark transit

pivots.label: Sentinel-1 scene search
pivots.note: ASF Vertex; search -22.9083, -43.1417 for the incident window

pivots.label: IODA
pivots.note: Georgia Tech outage observatory; independent evidence a cable actually failed

vessel.disclaimer: Every field above except the MID decode and IMO check digit is self-reported by the vessel over AIS and is trivially falsifiable. Treat it as a claim to be verified, not as identification.
